Going by what was known on 20 August 2023, is it true that Ms Căpraru went to Alexandria Technical College as of 8 February 2024? Given that Doinița manages Ananya, was Winter in Maramureș written by Doinița? Remind me, how many people cook at the Botanical Garden in Bălți? Does Lucía still work at Nordwind Systems? Fact-check: Ms Rădulescu is on the payroll of Greenline Transport. Could you check if Iancu doesn't grow peppers? Who works at Atelier Popa and is over 60 years old? Besides Constantin Florea, I'd like to know who is married to Kaveh. Not counting Chen, please find out who is the spouse of Hao. I was wondering whether The Last Ferry was written by Valentina.

How many years did Sofía work for Tisa Textiles? Not counting Mircea, please find out who trains Rapid Nairobi. Could you check if Carpathia Energy published The Salt Road? can Olive Stone collect keys? Going by what was known on September 25, 2023, do you know if Greenline Transport employed Valentina on March 20, 2024? Please find out who borrows Soups of Transylvania. The novel is overdue by two days. How old is Ms Iordache? Which property that George owns costs the least? Gheorghe was based in Oradea as of 2 March 2023, correct? Is it the case that Mr Moreau is a child of Mr Balogh? How many times did Tamás borrow The Salt Road? I wonder if Oana Lazăr is the doctor of Mr Smith.

In what period was Ghiță based in Cluj-Napoca? How much time did Raluca Mocanu rent the old sailing boat? Anca is the author of The Glass Orchard, right? Nadia booked the van and collected the keys and returned the old permit.

Is it true that Minh is trained? I wonder whether the external examiner for the MSc in Applied Biostatistics at the Faculty of Medicine in Craiova has been appointed yet. Did Zakaria tighten the stern line before the rain began? Did Zoltán start working at Galați Logistics after Bohdan did? When exactly was Mr Adeyemi married to Fatima? When exactly did Aditya go to Piatra Neamț Arts High School? Which property that Alexandru owns costs the least? Not counting Iancu, please find out who owns the holiday cottage in Bran. Do you know if Iulia Dobre looked after the analytics pipeline as of 23 September 2019? Besides Larisa, tell me who works for Orion Robotics. Nikos Nikolaidis reports to Tunde. Does Grace rent the recording studio, do you know? Fact-check: Élodie wrote The Salt Road.

Should Mei accept the offer from Greenline Transport? Please find out who goes on a trip to Craiova. Not counting Lucian, please find out who shows up at the photography workshop. When exactly did Atelier Stan employ Silviu? Which property that George owns costs the least? Valentina Navarro is the doctor of Eleni. Do you know if Bogdan-Ionuț wants to move to Valencia? When did Emre start to maintain the booking app? Parisa raises Iurie Rotaru, correct? In what period did Kavya live in Kraków? Is it true that not all players of CS Osaka are certified? How many people reside in Buzău, if you know? Can I collect my car before the garage closes? Until what date did Hao go on a trip to Pitești?

Until what date did Constantin Neagu rent the vineyard near Sibiu? Do you know if Sofía attends classes at Osaka Arts High School and Blue Harbor Media employs Sofía? Is it true that Wojciech resides in Cluj-Napoca? Who works at a company in Kraków? The novel is overdue by two days. Is it the case that Thomas Walker is a child of Thảo? Fact-check: Ms Rădulescu is on the payroll of Greenline Transport. Which doctors treat someone who is allergic to lactose? Please find out who checked out Soups of Transylvania. Just checking: does Blue Harbor Media not sell second-hand laptops?

Kasia has not found the missing collar in the garden. Ms Pătrașcu doesn't take part in the wedding reception, and Ms Kim takes part in the photography workshop. How long did Hao play for Rapid Focșani? Since Arjun is the chef at the Alba Iulia Arena, do you know if Wei Zhao cooks at the Alba Iulia Arena? Does Lucía still work at Nordwind Systems? How does Manon pay, any idea? Can you tell me who studies at Ploiești Technical College? Who works at Carpathia Energy and is over 40 years old? I don't work at Nordwind Systems, but does my sister work at Nordwind Systems? I was wondering whether Katrin is the doctor of Ms Mureșan.

Not counting Tatiana,        find out who looks after the reporting dashboard.
The driver says Gabriel's flight will land after midnight.
Can the chef prepare a smaller portion?
Is there anyone at Atelier Voicu who works there but does not live in Chengdu?
Could you check if Carmen attended the spring book fair?
Is it true that Tisa Textiles employs Mr Popescu?
In what period did Fatima Mansour look after the VPN gateway?
Does Tudor still live in Buzău?
How much time did Beatriz look after the login service?
Which people work at which companies in Vaslui?
Are most players of Rapid Deva certified?
Explain to me why the login service is out of service.
Ms Tănase is certified         ?
Is it the case that Vlad is trained?
Is it the case that Ms Mwangi played for the Busan Wolves as of June 6, 2021?
Who cooks at the Craiova Arena             ?
Nadia booked the van and collected the keys and returned the old permit.
Where does Roxana live, Lyon       ?
Arjun doesn't own the holiday cottage in Bran.
Up to what date was Agnieszka Nowak enrolled at Tóth Primary School?
Is the bridge toll separate from the quoted fare?
When exactly did Csaba look after the analytics pipeline?
Who works at Blue Harbor Media and is over 30 years old?

sop:
@b0 stated
  relation "land"
  role subject "Gabriel's flight"
  valid on "midnight"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "The driver"

@b1 stated
  relation "book"
  role subject "Nadia"
  role object "the van"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@b2 stated
  relation "collect"
  role subject "Nadia"
  role object "the keys"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@b3 stated
  relation "return"
  role subject "Nadia"
  role object "the old permit"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@b4 query
  select ?place
  where all
    match
      relation "live in"
      role subject ?p
      role location ?place
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "manage"
      role object "Paula Rădulescu"
      role subject ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@b5 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the reporting dashboard"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  except ?x "Tatiana"

@b6 query
  where match
    relation "can prepare"
    role subject "the chef"
    role object "a smaller portion"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b7 query
  mode exists
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object "Atelier Voicu"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "live in"
      role location "Chengdu"
      role subject ?x
      polarity negated
    end
  end

@b8 query
  where match
    relation "attend"
    role subject "Carmen"
    role object "the spring book fair"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b9 query
  where match
    relation "employ"
    role subject "Tisa Textiles"
    role object "Mr Popescu"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b10 query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Fatima Mansour"
    role object "the VPN gateway"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b11 query
  where match
    relation "live in"
    role subject "Tudor"
    role location "Buzău"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b12 query
  select ?t
  measure duration
  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Beatriz"
    role object "the login service"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b13 query
  select ?x ?x2
  where all
    match
      relation "work at"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?x2
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be in"
      role subject ?x2
      role location "Vaslui"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

@b14 query
  mode every
  quantifier most
  where match
    relation "be a player of"
    role subject ?m
    role object "Rapid Deva"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  scope match
    relation "be certified"
    role subject ?m
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b15 query
  mode explain
  where match
    relation "be out of service"
    role subject "the login service"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b16 query
  where match
    relation "be certified"
    role subject "Ms Tănase"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b17 query
  where match
    relation "be trained"
    role subject "Vlad"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b18 query
  where match
    relation "play for"
    role subject "Ms Mwangi"
    role object "the Busan Wolves"
    polarity affirmed
  end
  at "June 6 2021"

@b19 query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "cook at"
    role subject ?x
    role object "the Craiova Arena"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b20 query
  select ?place
  where match
    relation "live in"
    role subject "Roxana"
    role location ?place
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b21 query
  where match
    relation "own"
    role subject "Arjun"
    role object "the holiday cottage in Bran"
    polarity negated
  end

@b22 query
  select ?t
  measure end
  where match
    relation "be enrolled at"
    role subject "Agnieszka Nowak"
    role object "Tóth Primary School"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b23 query
  where match
    relation "be separate from"
    role subject "the bridge toll"
    role source "the quoted fare"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@b24 query

  where match
    relation "look after"
    role subject "Csaba"

@b25 query

    match

      role object "Blue Harbor Media"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be old"
      role subject ?x
      role object ?age
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?age above 30

message: Could you check if Mihai goes to Rădulescu Primary School? How does Oliver get to work? Hypothetically, if Ms Eze teaches German, can you check whether Haruka teaches German? Fact-check: Rahul Reddy plants peppers. Alexandria Children's Clinic is located in Craiova. How many times did Ms Martínez borrow Soups of Transylvania? Do you know if Grace does not borrow The Salt Road? When exactly was Chen Wang the trainer of the Reșița Falcons? Is it the case that the mail server depends on the VPN gateway? In what period was Mr Toma the spouse of Kavya? I wonder if Ioana studies at Saint Andrew High School in Cluj-Napoca. Honestly, should Aiko Watanabe accept the offer from Delta Print or not? Until what date did Mr Adeyemi plant apple trees? Since when is Maria enrolled at the Pitești Language School? Is the pavement icy? Does anyone working at Greenline Transport live in Piatra Neamț? Rémi rents the vineyard near Sibiu. Is the school bus not repaired by Ethan Smith, do you know? How come the reporting dashboard is out of service? Remind me, what does Lars grow? Is it true that Alejandro is a child of Răzvan Manole? Do you know until when Élodie was the trainer of Bistrița United? Tunde Okafor doesn't attend classes at Rusu Primary School. Karim Mansour is the trainer of Bistrița United.

The Passport Office in Porto issues a building permit, correct? Do you know until when Rubina was married to Cătălin? How many times was the product launch postponed? Apart from Kenji, how many people work at Popescu & Partners? In what period did Aditya go to Piatra Neamț Arts High School? Remind me, how many people reside in Alexandria? Going by what was known on July 20, 2023, could you check if Veaceslav Cebotari went to Alexandria Technical College on 26 July 2024? Did Octavian start working at Nordwind Systems after Thảo did? The buffet starts when Farah arrives. Is it true that Karim attended the chess tournament? Not counting James, please find out who has an allergy to peanuts. Farah called on Monday and the desk promised an update but the application still shows pending. The harbor gate is shut. Who works at a company in Pune? Explain to me why the jazz evening was postponed. How many people who work at Blue Harbor Media are over 30 years old? Is it true that not all players of Olimpia Iași are certified? Mădălina is the author of Letters to a Young Engineer?

I don't work at Carpathia Energy, but does my sister work at Carpathia Energy?
Not counting Fatima,        find out who looks after the mail server.
Remind me when the bakery on the corner belonged to Jack.
find out where Iancu lives.
What does Emil pay with?
Is it the case that Lucian has borrowed The Salt Road?
Is it true that Mr Phạm owns the vineyard near Sibiu?
should Jun accept the offer from Orion Robotics       ?
Is it the case that Alejandro does not attend classes at Cahul Technical College?
How long did Nordwind Systems stock garden furniture?
Do you know until when Youssef looked after the payroll database?
A 38 mm tyre fits that old rim.
Ana-Maria will bring the updated chart to the morning briefing.
The bakery on the corner belongs to Mircea, and the flat on Mihai Viteazu Street belongs to Ioana.
Did Thiago start living in Galați after Burak did?
Does the rental counter open at 6 on April 12?
When exactly did Ioana give classes in piano?
Does Hao Li manage anyone who lives in Buzău?
How come Arjun resigned?
How many people who work at Carpathia Energy are over 45 years old?
Min-jun flies to Buzău.
Are exactly half of the players of Valencia United certified?
Would the crew, when the road reopens, collect the bins from the closed end?

Is Camelia waiting near the east entrance to Meridian Hall? Remind me, who is the trainer of CS Valencia? Please find out who borrows Soups of Transylvania. I need to know if Ruxandra raises Ananya. I don't work at Atelier Oprea, but does my brother work at Atelier Oprea? Which people work at which companies in Lagos? Honestly, should Sigrid accept the offer from Delta Print or not? Do you know if Ms Neagu does not cook at the Botanical Garden in Alexandria? On how many occasions did Brightfield Foods stock winter tyres? Not counting Minh, please find out who the fire engine is repaired by. Who works at a company in Craiova? Not counting Łukasz Mazur, please find out who flies to Nairobi. I was wondering whether Emeka managed George in 2020. How many vehicles are repaired by Théo, if you know? What were the dates when Dorin coached Deva United? The children's desk closes at five. Since Zoltán plays for the Orhei Falcons, could you check if Hao Li is on the Orhei Falcons? Who rents the holiday cottage in Bran, if you know? In what period did Mehmet report to Alexandru Căpraru?

Remind me when Jürgen maintained the booking app. Did Lucian Nistor start working at Atelier Moldovan after Bohdan did? Who signed the certificate? Does Mr Sârbu not lease the vineyard near Sibiu, do you know? Do you know until when the fire engine was repaired by Valentina? The wind eased and the harbor pilot called twice but the ferry stayed near the outer buoy. Fact-check: Mr Popa goes to Lazăr Primary School. How old is Viorica?

Explain to me why the reporting dashboard is down. Who works at a company in Bălți? Is none of the players of CS Nairobi certified? Has Luca returned the wrench? Is it true that Yan is on the payroll of Greenline Transport? Do you know until when Karim played for Olimpia Brașov? Did Sorin check the bilge? Is the fire engine repaired by Petru, do you know? Which ladder needs oil? In what period was Brândușa based in Bistrița? I'm trying to find out where Liviu Munteanu is based. Do you know if Vertex Analytics did not publish Notes from the Night Train? In what period did Csaba cook at the Botanical Garden in Buzău? Is it true that Sophie does not attend the wedding reception? Fact-check: Rafael reports to Natalia Cebotari. Is the pavement icy? How many people who work at Delta Print are over 50 years old? How many people go to Bistrița Technical College, if you know? Not counting Joaquín Martínez, please find out who trains the Botoșani Falcons. For how long was Emre responsible for the payments gateway? Please find out who goes on a trip to Craiova. Is none of the players of CS Reșița certified? Please tell Zahra whether the driver has reached Pine Square. Remind me, who does Vertex Analytics employ? Not counting Kenji, please find out who the school bus is repaired by. Does Felix Schmidt not show up at the product launch, do you know?

Could you check if Mirela goes on a trip to Reșița? Andreea will pick up the dessert tray. Can Kofi collect the fare? Did Seo-yeon Choi start living in Vaslui after Eleni did? Atelier Szabó is a supplier of Carpathia Energy. The harbor gate is shut. Not counting Amira Mansour, please find out who treats Răzvan. Please find out who checked out Soups of Transylvania. Since Arjun is the chef at the Alba Iulia Arena, do you know if Wei Zhao cooks at the Alba Iulia Arena? Which property that Alexandru owns costs the least? How does Manon pay, any idea? In what period was Andreea based in Galați? How many times did Otilia Tănase fly to Bergen? Until when was Aditya responsible for the inventory API? Are the rear brakes ready for inspection? Do you know if Ms Neagu does not cook at the Botanical Garden in Alexandria? I don't work at Greenline Transport, but does my brother work at Greenline Transport? Marwan will arrive at 10, and the ride takes 35 minutes. Explain to me why the payroll database is out of service. What does Mr Zhang commute by? I'm trying to find out who works for Brightfield Foods. Is it the case that Greenline Transport employed Hao as of the 1st of July 2023?

message: Do you know if Hao treats Iurie? Do you know until when Răzvan was the spouse of Wojciech? Going by what was known on 25 July 2023, is it true that Kaveh went to Varga Primary School on March 14, 2024? Vertex Analytics sells printer ink. Has Oana paid the deposit? Is Olivia Brown allowed to sign a tax clearance certificate? How does Oliver get to work? Anca is the author of The Glass Orchard, right? How old is Ms Mocanu? Does Matei reside in Brașov or not? Could you check if Astrid intends to attend the Tuesday board meeting? I need to know if Moritz was the spouse of Bogdan on August 1, 2020. Not counting Sophie, please find out who goes on a trip to Osaka. Fact-check: Csaba isn't the trainer of the Valencia Wolves. In what period did Chen look after the mail server? If the wind rises before dusk, will Elif move the tender to berth 6? I don't work at Nordwind Systems, but does my sister work at Nordwind Systems? Faris will inspect the rescue rings after the morning tide falls. Fact-check: Nils Nilsen is the chef at the Community Centre on Elm Street. Can I collect my car before the garage closes? Apart from Luminița, how many people work at Piatra Neamț Logistics? Since Daria Stan is a parent of Sofía, is it true that Greenline Transport employs Daria Stan? How much time did Răzvan grow roses? I was wondering whether Katrin is based in Nairobi.

Since Veaceslav Guțu leases the red Dacia, is it true that Élodie Martin leases the red Dacia? Not counting Amira Haddad, please find out who is a member of the Madrigal choir. Is Nils Andersen the chef at the Old Mill Hall, do you know? Fact-check: the payroll database relies on the VPN gateway. Since Iulia is a child of Élodie Girard, do you know if Élodie Girard is a child of Iulia? When was the Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest finished? When was Babes-Bolyai University founded? Fact-check: Esmeralda is not the spouse of James. Layla is a parent of Ms Țurcanu, correct? I wonder how Mr Diaconu goes to work. Who rents the holiday cottage in Bran, if you know? How many people who work at Bălan & Partners are over 60 years old? Gheorghe was based in Oradea as of 2 March 2023, correct?

message: Fact-check: Élodie leases the vineyard near Sibiu. The buffet starts when Farah arrives. Do you know if Mirela attends classes at the Izmir Language School? Timișoara Logistics does not stock school uniforms. I was wondering whether Emeka managed George in 2020. Anca is the author of The Glass Orchard, right? Could you check if Bohdan resides in Szeged? Where does the person who manages Paula Rădulescu live? How old is Zeynep? Why exactly is the Old Mill Hall closed? Which pier serves the launch? Eira locked the locker and Halim took the key and the night crew signed the log. Did Octavian start working at Nordwind Systems after Thảo did? I'd like to know who checked out Winter in Maramureș. Is it true that not all players of Alexandria United are certified? How many people cook at the Cahul Arena, if you know? Just checking: does the bakery on the corner belong to Andrei Barbu? When exactly did Ioana give classes in piano? Since Raluca gets to work by tram, what does Bohdan commute by? Not counting Bogdan Tănase, please find out who owns the plot of land by the river. Chinedu is a child of Grace. What about Jun? Can you explain why the search index is not out of service? Who works at Blue Harbor Media and is over 30 years old? Fact-check: Ayşe shows up at the spring book fair. Please find out where the Buzău Tax Office is located. Could you check if Iancu doesn't grow peppers? Explain to me why the product launch was postponed. Is it the case that Lucian has borrowed The Salt Road? Apart from Ilinca, how many people work at Vertex Analytics? Who works at a company in Craiova? Please find out who looks after the login service.

I don't work at Toma & Partners, but does my sister work at Toma & Partners? Not counting Victor Gheorghiu, please find out who flies to Valencia. Is it true that Thomas doesn't reside in Cluj-Napoca? When does Daria inspect Plover? Since the school bus is repaired by Matei Tănase, could you check if the school bus is repaired by Alejandro? I'd like to know who is based in Bacău. Who works at a company in Deva? Nikos Nikolaidis reports to Tunde. who drove Can Şahin home? Could you check if Ethan is not the trainer of Rapid Orhei? message: In what period did Alexandru lease the plot of land by the river? Are most players of Rapid Deva certified? Not counting Daniel, please find out who rents the vineyard near Sibiu. Fact-check: a birth certificate is not issued by the Bistrița Land Office. I need to know when Mircea lived in Leipzig. Do you know until when Silviu reported to Nils? Mr Constantinescu plays for Rapid Alba Iulia. Since Ms Haddad attends the parents' evening, and Lucian attends the parents' evening, is it the case that Tamás does not attend the parents' evening? Does Matei reside in Brașov or not? Did Silviu start living in Reșița after Chinedu did? Is it true that Arjun wants to move to Cluj-Napoca? Is it the case that Vertex Analytics stocks LED bulbs? Fact-check: the payroll database doesn't rely on the login service. Do you know who is responsible for the billing service? How many times was the warehouse forklift repaired by Smaranda? Olena Melnyk travels to Ploiești? Out of curiosity, why is Viorel ill? Going by what was known on 14 July 2025, is it true that Sophie was based in Szeged on 23 April 2024? Who works at Carpathia Energy and is over 40 years old? Not counting Minh, please find out who the fire engine is repaired by. Since James gets to work by minibus, what does Liam Clarke commute by? Fact-check: Ms Rădulescu is on the payroll of Greenline Transport. Who is the new interim head of accounts payable for the Central and Eastern European shared service centre in Timisoara? Since Iulia is a child of Élodie Girard, do you know if Élodie Girard is a child of Iulia? Hyejin checked the tire pressure. Could the mechanic call Radu when the filter arrives? I don't work at Stan & Partners, but does my brother work at Stan & Partners? How long did Nordwind Systems stock garden furniture? Mădălina is the author of Letters to a Young Engineer? Is it true that not all players of Olimpia Iași are certified? Please find out who leases the vineyard near Sibiu. Fact-check: Gábor does not rent the vineyard near Sibiu.

message: Quick question: does Larisa take part in the spring book fair? Which people work at which companies in Vaslui? Could you check if the reporting dashboard relies on the billing service? Do you know until when Silviu went to Nistor Primary School? When exactly did Ghiță live in Cluj-Napoca? Can the chef prepare a smaller portion? The limitation period for a simple breach of contract claim is six years, right? Fact-check: Mr Popa goes to Lazăr Primary School. Does Tudor still live in Buzău? On how many occasions did Layla plant lavender? Because the bridge is closed, will Kamil take the riverside road? How many times did Meera look after the backup cluster? Can you confirm that Jun Zhao does not have an allergy to latex? Not counting Aiko, please find out who intends to attend the parents' evening. In what period did Mr Lazăr own the old sailing boat? Are exactly half of the players of the Vaslui Wolves certified? Is it the case that Kavya reports to Alexandru? A gull struck the mast. Why exactly is the inventory API out of service? When exactly was Natalia Cebotari married to Otilia? Until when was Takumi Watanabe the spouse of Mr Oliveira? Who rents the holiday cottage in Bran, if you know? Besides Radu Ungureanu, could you check who is the coach of Olimpia Sibiu? I'm trying to find out who is employed by Brightfield Foods. Where does Mehmet live, Busan, right? How much time did Răzvan grow roses? Is Meera allowed to sign a work permit? Is it true that Otilia is based in Busan? Since Roxana is allergic to pollen, is it true that Petronela Anghel is allergic to pollen? How does Viorica get to work, do you know? Do you know if Ms Farahani is the chef at the Bergen Arena and the white camper van is repaired by Ms Farahani? When does the reading club meet?

Would you say that Silviu Sârbu is not the chef at the Brașov Philharmonic? Remind me, which town does Dariush fly to? I was wondering whether Daniel has a job at Delta Print. True or false: Andreea is enrolled at Ploiești Technical College. The wind eased and the harbor pilot called twice but the ferry stayed near the outer buoy. Is Enikő older than Mr Constantinescu? How about Mr Hughes? Do you know until when Greenline Transport employed Ana? Not counting Olivia, please find out who treats Emma. How many times did Ms Martínez borrow Soups of Transylvania? Is Petronela not a member of the Madrigal choir, do you know? Does the rental counter open at 6 on April 12? How many people who work at Blue Harbor Media are over 30 years old? Is there anyone at Atelier Voicu who works there but does not live in Chengdu? Is it true that Petronela went to the Zalău Language School on 23 February 2018?

message: Remind me, how many people reside in Buzău? How many times did Otilia Tănase fly to Bergen? Since Bogdan-Ionuț Florea reports to Petru, could you check if Petru reports to Bogdan-Ionuț Florea? Mr Wang trains Rapid Piatra Neamț. Not counting Fatima, please find out who looks after the mail server. Would you say that Ngozi rents the vineyard near Sibiu? Is it the case that Greenline Transport employed Arjun on 1 June 2019? Tell me whether Attila was responsible for the inventory API as of February 1, 2020. Is it true that the Craiova Town Hall issues a birth certificate? Just checking: does Irina raise Layla? Would a digital signature from Piotr Nowak suffice for the license renewal? Which ladder needs oil? Please find out who trains Craiova United. I wonder if Chloé Moreau was employed by Pitești Logistics on December 1, 2024. How many offices issue a tax clearance certificate? Do you know until when Florică Lăutaru owned the vineyard near Sibiu? Did Krzysztof Krawczyk start living in Valencia before Aiko did? Given that Doinița manages Ananya, was Winter in Maramureș written by Doinița? In what period did Veaceslav Cebotari go to Lisbon Technical College? Is it the case that the analytics pipeline doesn't depend on the VPN gateway? What is the normal reference range for serum sodium? Do you know if Vertex Analytics did not publish Notes from the Night Train? Do you know how Jack gets to work? Who works at a company in Arad? I don't work at Greenline Transport, but does my brother work at Greenline Transport? Does anyone working at Atelier Becker live in Tulcea? Please find out where Andrei is based. Is it true that not all players of the Focșani Falcons are certified? Since Iancu reports to Wojciech, is it the case that Wojciech reports to Iancu? How many people who work at Alexandria Logistics are over 55 years old? Is Owen allowed to sign a criminal record certificate? Are all the players of CS Galați certified?

Quick question: does the Baia Mare Town Hall not issue a driving licence? Until what date was Élodie the trainer of Bistrița United? In what period did Brândușa live in Bistrița? I was wondering whether The Last Ferry was written by Valentina. Which people work at which companies in Reșița? How long did Greenline Transport employ Alejandro? Not counting Kenji, please find out who the school bus is repaired by. Is my permit ready? Is it the case that Thomas Walker is a child of Thảo?

message: Not counting Amira Mansour, please find out who treats Răzvan. Who works at a company in Piatra Neamț? Do you know if Lars is certified? In what period did Csaba cook at the Botanical Garden in Buzău? Amira did not write Soups of Transylvania. Fact-check: Rafael reports to Natalia Cebotari. Did Sorin Neagu start living in Pitești before Owen did? Could you check if Carpathia Energy published The Salt Road? Just checking: is Tatiana the author of The Glass Orchard? Fact-check: Arjun plants pumpkins. Do you know why the jazz evening was postponed? Honestly, is Laura Hughes employed by the Riverside Medical Centre in Pune? Is it the case that Théo grows peppers? Please find out where Silviu lives. I don't work at Nordwind Systems, but does my sister work at Nordwind Systems? Which property that George owns costs the least? Remind me, who does Vertex Analytics employ? Apart from Kenji, how many people work at Popescu & Partners? Until what date did Mr Adeyemi plant apple trees? How old is Ms Iordache? Not counting Bogdan Oprea, please find out who sings in the Madrigal choir. Is it true that Alexandru went to Osaka Music Academy on 1 March 2024? Fact-check: Tisa Textiles sells school uniforms. Is it true that Atelier Rădulescu doesn't stock olive oil? Are all the players of the Leipzig Wolves certified? Do you know until when Răzvan was the spouse of Wojciech? Does Katalin need an appointment? Is it the case that Veaceslav reports to Mr Rădulescu? No skiffs left yesterday. How often did Julien take part in the charity run? Will the night bus stop beside the public library? Does Mr Sârbu not lease the vineyard near Sibiu, do you know? The display is still blank. How many times did Tamás borrow The Salt Road? Did Mr Nilsen start working at Atelier Neagu after Doina did? When exactly did Jun report to Zoltán Varga? Since Arjun is the chef at the Alba Iulia Arena, do you know if Wei Zhao cooks at the Alba Iulia Arena? I need to know where Ilinca is based. Who goes to Müller Primary School, if you know? Tell me whether Lena Becker lives in Bergen. Which doctors treat someone who is allergic to lactose? Please find out who flies to Cahul. In what period was Mr Toma the spouse of Kavya? When exactly did Dorin own the vineyard near Sibiu? Apart from Luminița, how many people work at Piatra Neamț Logistics? Fact-check: Nordwind Systems does not carry school uniforms. Is the water supply interrupted throughout the lower district? How does Manon pay, any idea? Please find out where Grace lives. How long did Răzvan go to Arad Technical College?

message: Would you say that Paweł is a member of the Madrigal choir? Is it true that Natalia Guțu reports to Veaceslav Cebotari? Not counting Carmen, please find out who attends the charity run. Is it the case that Iurie Cebotari treats Hao? Do you know until when Florin was based in Sighișoara? Sorin missed the airport turn. Does Grace rent the recording studio, do you know? Is it true that not all players of the Timișoara Falcons are certified? When exactly was Silviu Toma the spouse of Kavya? What's the half-life of amiodarone? I wonder if the Passport Office in Porto issues a building permit. Fact-check: Nils Nilsen is the chef at the Community Centre on Elm Street. What were the dates when Roxana taught German? Are exactly half of the players of Osaka United certified? Who goes on a trip to Reșița, if you know? Could you check if Arjun doesn't cook at the Buzău Philharmonic? Up to what date did Doinița Rotaru play for the Lviv Falcons? For how long did Sofía have a job at Tisa Textiles? Did Nils Andersen start living in Busan after Corina did? Min-jun flies to Buzău. Is Camelia waiting near the east entrance to Meridian Hall? I need to know if Dariush Farahani is on the Deva Wolves. Fact-check: Meera does not grow apple trees. Remind me, how many people reside in Brașov? In what period was Sophie Brown the chef at the Bălți Arena? Is the Banca Transilvania branch in Iulius Town open on Saturday? Apart from Luminița, how many people work at Piatra Neamț Logistics? Until when was Aditya responsible for the inventory API? Is it the case that Carpathia Energy doesn't carry LED bulbs? Do you know why Mr Müller does not stay home? Who will collect the keyboard from the repair shop tomorrow? Can you tell me what is in Baia Mare?

Did Nils Andersen start living in Busan after Corina did? Min-jun flies to Buzău. Is Camelia waiting near the east entrance to Meridian Hall? I need to know if Dariush Farahani is on the Deva Wolves. message: Should Tunde Balogun accept the offer from Nordwind Systems? Not counting Lucian, please find out who shows up at the photography workshop. Would you say Fatima is older than Lucian? Is it true that Nils is the chef at the Old Mill Hall? Is it the case that Atelier Wilson sells LED bulbs? The dispatcher phoned Daria twice. Could you check if Carmen attended the spring book fair? Are exactly half of the players of Valencia United certified? I was wondering whether Oluwaseun was responsible for the backup cluster on 1 March 2018. Remind me, how many people reside in Brașov? How often did Mr Lazăr check out A Short History of Bridges? Is Noah the author of Letters to a Young Engineer? I'm trying to find out where Liviu Munteanu is based. Is it true that not all players of Olimpia Iași are certified? The clerk gave Andreea a numbered receipt on Tuesday. In what period did Aditya go to Piatra Neamț Arts High School? Please find out who trains the Bălți Falcons. Is it the case that Vlad is trained? Did the office, after Irina signed the register, issue a receipt? Did Constantin Ciobanu start living in Brașov before Oluwaseun did? When was the Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest finished? How many times did Łukasz lease the vineyard near Sibiu? message: How many times did Ms Martínez borrow Soups of Transylvania? Could you check if Petronela rents the vineyard near Sibiu? How many times did Meera look after the backup cluster? Are all the players of Olimpia Tulcea certified? In what period did Matei Voicu go to Ardeleanu Primary School? Does the tap, although the tanker has left, still need testing today? When exactly did Ioana give classes in piano? Remind me, what does Atelier Schmidt stock? Who works at Atelier Popa and is over 60 years old? Is it true that Reșița Logistics employed Ms Balogh in 2022? In what period did Alejandro teach computer science? Please find out who the school bus is repaired by. How much time did Shirin reside in Tulcea? How old is Ms Mocanu? Marwan will arrive at 10, and the ride takes 35 minutes. I wonder whether the external examiner for the MSc in Applied Biostatistics at the Faculty of Medicine in Craiova has been appointed yet. I wonder how Grace goes to work. Do you know when Beatriz maintained the search index? Does Bohdan reside in Szeged or not? How far is Sofia from here? Not counting James, please find out who has an allergy to peanuts. Is Sorin checking the spokes? Besides Radu Ungureanu, could you check who is the coach of Olimpia Sibiu? Are the ropes dry? Fact-check: Arjun plants pumpkins. Explain to me why the payroll database is out of service. Did Constantin Ciobanu start living in Brașov before Oluwaseun did? Fact-check: Iancu doesn't train Bistrița United. Is Kavya allowed to sign a residence certificate? Fact-check: Teodora does not play for CS Bistrița. I need to know if Ruxandra raises Ananya. Until what date was the fire engine repaired by Nour? Fact-check: Tunde does not intend to attend the parents' evening. Is the Banca Transilvania branch in Iulius Town open on Saturday? Do you know if Ms Farahani is the chef at the Bergen Arena and the white camper van is repaired by Ms Farahani? When exactly did Aditya go to Piatra Neamț Arts High School? Is Petronela not a member of the Madrigal choir, do you know? Just checking: does Blue Harbor Media not sell second-hand laptops? Fact-check: Paloma goes to Țurcanu Primary School. Chinedu is a child of Grace. Based on what we knew on July 9, 2025, can you check whether Vikram coached CS Botoșani as of 20 September 2024? The Passport Office in Porto issues a building permit, correct? In what period was Sigrid the spouse of Bohdan? Does Hiroshi Sato manage anyone who lives in Botoșani? Please find out who trains Craiova United. Does Ms Balogun plan to relocate to Bacău? How does Viorica get to work, do you know? How come Florin stays home?

Not counting Tatiana, please find out who looks after the reporting dashboard. Is it the case that Lucian has borrowed The Salt Road? Do you know until when Florin was based in Sighișoara? Honestly, should Sigrid accept the offer from Delta Print or not? Is none of the players of the Bălți Wolves certified? Does Arjun cook at the Buzău Philharmonic or not? I wonder if Parisa Tehrani is a parent of Iurie. Emre Yılmaz was married to Brândușa Lazăr on 27 March 2019, correct? I need to know when Hiroshi lived in Tulcea. What does Nils commute by? Where did Krzysztof travel? I wonder how Mr Diaconu goes to work. Is the terrace open for lunch on Tuesday? The display is still blank. Fact-check: Rafael reports to Natalia Cebotari. The vet did not promise that the results would arrive today. I need to know if Moritz was the spouse of Bogdan on August 1, 2020. Explain to me why the jazz evening was postponed. Fact-check: Aiko Tanaka does not treat Mehmet. In what period was Răzvan married to Alejandro? How old is Viorica? Who works at a company in Timișoara? Since Raluca gets to work by tram, what does Bohdan commute by? How many times did Mr Varga borrow The Salt Road? How many times did Arjun Patel lease the vineyard near Sibiu? Quick question: does the Baia Mare Town Hall not issue a driving licence? Fact-check: a birth certificate is not issued by the Bistrița Land Office. Did Tudor start living in Botoșani after Florică did? When exactly was Chen Wang the trainer of the Reșița Falcons? Which people work at which companies in Lagos? How does Oliver get to work? Does anyone working at Greenline Transport live in Piatra Neamț? If the car is damaged, does the deposit cover the repair? Remind me, who is the trainer of CS Valencia? Fact-check: Csaba isn't the trainer of the Valencia Wolves. Is it true that not all players of CS Osaka are certified? The buffet starts when Farah arrives. Just checking: is Tatiana the author of The Glass Orchard? Where is DHL Supply Chain headquartered? When exactly did Nils train CS Buzău? For how long was Emre responsible for the payments gateway? I don't work at Greenline Transport, but does my brother work at Greenline Transport? The novel is overdue by two days. When exactly did Csaba Varga cook at the Botanical Garden in Buzău? Please find out who looks after the login service.
